metadata.description: Bounded mushroom body circuit: projection neurons, Kenyon cells, output neurons and dopaminergic neurons. Roles assigned by exact type labels chosen by the project.

methodology.selection: PN, MBON and DAN: round-robin across exact types by body ID. KC: round-robin across exact types, each ordered by total input from the selected PNs. All induced edges at the threshold are kept; none are dropped.
methodology.roleBasis: Reward/punishment DAN split follows the literature (PAM ~ reward, PPL1 ~ punishment); it is a project decision, not a dataset annotation.
methodology.verification: Fresh queries for every retained identity, annotation, directed pair and exact raw weight.
